# NDTools

PowerShell module for Microsoft 365 administration (EntraID, Exchange Online, Intune, Teams)

Current version: **1.1.0**

## Install

```powershell
# once; PowerShell 7.4+ has PSResourceGet, Windows PowerShell 5.1: Install-Module Microsoft.PowerShell.PSResourceGet
Register-PSResourceRepository -Name Pages -Uri https://nic2045.github.io/psfeed/index.json -Trusted
Install-PSResource -Name NDTools -Repository Pages -Scope CurrentUser
Import-Module NDTools
Get-Command -Module NDTools
```

Update: `Update-PSResource NDTools`
